objective: Implement the Pi extension entry of the HolyAgent pi package so every Pi session gets its role from a launch flag and sees HolyAgent Intent status in its context, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-extension).
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext and run every command there; node_modules is installed. Gates: `bunx --no-install mise run verify` and `bunx --no-install mise run build` (build regenerates packages/integrations/pi/dist and packages/integrations/claude/dist; commit-ready output must be in sync).

Read first: AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md (repository rules: Effect, Effect Schema with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs, JSDoc on exports); docs/pi/extensions.md, docs/pi/configuration.md, docs/pi/orchestration.md, docs/pi/claude-parity.md and docs/pi/README.md (the design this implements); packages/integrations/pi/src/{extension,files,generate}.ts and build.ts (the current scaffold: extension.ts registers nothing yet); packages/runtime/src/config/ (the HolyAgent config loader with its pi section, already merged); the Claude session-start hook in packages/runtime and packages/integrations/claude (how status and reconcile are produced, the 9,300-character budget, the marked core span of the root rules) — mirror its behavior, do not fork its logic. Pi API notes: /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-deps.md and /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/. Do not run the pi binary.

Implement: (1) the default-exported factory receiving ExtensionAPI; it starts no process, socket, watcher or timer in the factory body; anything it needs is created in session_start and released in an idempotent session_shutdown. (2) A launch flag via pi.registerFlag / pi.getFlag: --holyagent-role with values root (the default, so plain pi starts the HolyAgent root), specialist (a child the root launches: status only, no root rules) and session (any other session: the marked core span of the root rules plus status); an unknown value fails closed with a clear message. (3) On session start (startup, reload, new, resume, fork) and on session_compact, run `holyagent status` through pi.exec, plus `holyagent reconcile` after resume and compaction, and deliver the result as a message on the next run via before_agent_start or pi.sendMessage, never by changing the system prompt. (4) The status context stays within the same 9,300-character budget as the Claude hook and adds nothing when the project has no .holyagent folder. (5) In a session-role session add the marked core span of the root rules (from the Kimi family, kimi-k3.1, which is the Pi family; reuse the existing core-span extraction); the root gets only the status here, because its full text reaches the system prompt through the launcher change. (6) Handlers are short and fail closed (a failing status call adds a one-line notice, never throws into pi), and nothing depends on TUI-only APIs, so TUI, RPC, JSON and print modes all work. (7) The extension reaches the runtime only through a scripts/holyagent wrapper shipped in the pi package; if the pi dist has no such wrapper and runtime bundle yet, add them to the pi build the way the Claude plugin ships scripts/holyagent.js, generated by build.ts and listed in the pi package files. (8) Load the HolyAgent config through the runtime loader; when pi.enable is false the extension registers nothing beyond the flag and adds no context; an invalid config stops with the loader's message naming the field.

Out of scope (later changes in this release): the Kimi provider, tool surface, the specialist launcher (root system-prompt carrier, per-role prompt files, codemode and env defaults for children, prompts/ templates), setup and doctor, T3 integration. Name anything you find they need in the report instead of building it.
constraints: Test with unit tests and synthesized fixtures only: a fake ExtensionAPI that records registered flags, handlers, exec calls and sent messages; no live pi or Kimi runs.
Keep the Claude generated output byte-identical (check git status on packages/integrations/claude/dist after build).
Make no version-control writes (no git add, commit, checkout, stash, worktree) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths for the root to commit.
Do not add dependencies except through the repository's updater (mise run deps:update); the pi host packages stay peer dependencies.
Report in under 450 words; start each evidence line with the criterion text, a colon, then the support; put long logs in a file outside the repository and give its path.

criteria.text: The factory starts nothing; session_start acquires and an idempotent session_shutdown releases, shown by tests
--holyagent-role selects root (default), specialist or session, and an unknown value fails closed, with tests
Status runs on every session start reason and on compaction, reconcile after resume and compaction, delivered as a message and never by editing the system prompt, with tests
Context stays within the 9,300-character budget and is empty without a .holyagent folder, with tests
A session-role session gets the marked core span of the Kimi root rules; root and specialist do not, with tests
Handlers fail closed and use no TUI-only API, with a test of a failing status call
The extension calls the runtime only through a scripts/holyagent wrapper shipped in the pi package dist
Config is loaded through the runtime loader, pi.enable false adds nothing, and an invalid config names the field
No regression: Claude dist byte-identical and generated output in sync after mise run build
Only the extension-entry scope is built; later-change needs are named, not built
